description: This file declares Bluetooth utility functions and inline helper functions for handling Bluetooth HCI filters and address conversions within the Thunder project.

methods.name: BtUtilsHciFilterClear
methods.description: Clears an hci_filter structure by setting all bytes to zero.

methods.name: BtUtilsHciSetBit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in a bitmask within the provided address.

methods.name: BtUtilsHciTestBit
methods.description: Tests if a specific bit is set in a bitmask within the provided address.

methods.name: BtUtilsHciFilterSetEvent
methods.description: Sets an event mask bit in an hci_filter structure.

methods.name: BtUtilsHciFilterSetPtype
methods.description: Sets a packet type bit in an hci_filter structure.
